root resolves scoped instructions and preserves material user constraints in downstream work and evidence
root selects a risk-scaled collaboration profile and owns all user-facing readiness decisions

material or high-risk late ambiguity reopens affected requirements before implementation continues

child completion is never product evidence without root verification
